questions.question: Which text type is meant to be objective and answer the 5 Ws?
questions.explanation: A news article informs objectively and answers Who, What, Where, When and Why. Opinion pieces present the author's viewpoint.

questions.question: In film, what is the effect of a low camera angle (looking up at a character)?
options: It makes the character look powerful
It makes the character look small and vulnerable
questions.explanation: A low angle makes the character appear powerful, while a high angle (looking down) makes them seem small or vulnerable.

questions.question: What is a close-up shot typically used for?
options: Showing a character's emotions in detail
questions.explanation: A close-up shows a face or object up close to reveal emotions and important details.

questions.question: How can fast editing (rapid cuts) affect a film scene?
options: It always makes the scene calm
questions.explanation: Rapid cuts create tension and energy, while slow editing invites reflection and calm.

questions.question: Which questions should you ask when analysing any non-fiction text or film?
options: What is the purpose, who is the audience, and how credible is it?
How long did it take to make?
How much money did it earn?
What is the author's favourite colour?
questions.explanation: All texts can be analysed by examining purpose, target audience, techniques used and credibility.
